main_text.l: poculum. Tradere de manu in manum. Porrigere & tendere alicui consilium, Cic. Contradere argumenta, Lucr. Transmittere alicui provinciam, Plin. Iun. Vid. Porrigere.
Traditio] Mos traditus ab antiquis, Hor. Traditum aliquid posteris. Tradita consuetudo, Cic. Traditum aliquid in posteros. Quint.
Traducere] Traduc matrem, & omnem familiam ad nos, Ter. Transducere, Cic. Transmovere, Tac. Vid. al. Diffamare.
Trahere] Cinibus trahere, Virg. Obtorto collo trahere, Plaut. Allicit magnes ferrum, Cic. Pellicit ad se, Lucr. Ducere aliquem capillis, Tibul. Magnetis more attrahere.
Trajectus] Trajectio. Transvectio. Transmissio, Vectura, Cic. Commeatus, Caes.
Trajicere] Transvehi navibus, Sallust. Transportari carina, Mart. Vid. Transfretare.

Tranquillare] Sedare mentes, Plin. Tranquillum animum, tranquillitatem facere, Plaut. In tranquillum redigere, Liv. Componere mentem, Cels. In tranquillum ex saevis tempestatibus transferre, Lucil. E tantis fluctibus in tranquillo locare, Lucr. Mulcere procellas. Mitigare aliquem, Cic. Mitificare, Plin. Mansuefacere, Liv. Evellere scrupulum alicui, Cic. Eximere, Plin.

Tranquillitas maris] Tranquillum, Plin. Status pacati aëris, Lucr. Silent venti, Sen. Quiescunt, Plin. Iun. Posuere venti, Virg. Mitescit fretum, Liv. Loca non pervia ventis, ex Ovid. Malacia maris, Caes. Pellacia maris, Lucr. Rid ent æquora, Ridet tempestas, Id. Mollities maris, Plin. Halcedonia, Plaut. Dies halcyonii, Varr. Halcyonides dies, Plin. Tractabile mare, Id. Undæ mollesc, Lucr. Flustra, pl. Fest.
Tranquillitas animi] Tranquillitas vitæ. Tranquilla vitæ frons. Otiosa senectus. Quietè acta ætas. Animus errore liber. Euthymia, Cic. Tranquillè placideque ducere vitam, Caes.

page.notes: Catchword "Tran-" is printed at the lower right. Some words in the faint show-through from the reverse side were ignored. "Undæ mollesc" is read as "Undæ molles" with uncertainty in the last letters.
